object_motion.note: cube: tracked 100 % of frames, median mask IoU 0.90; orientation up to the cube's 24 symmetries; layer turns not modelled

limitations: The source is a 2x slowed clip shown here at real time; a 30 fps capture is assumed and verified by the on-screen timer to within 1 %.
The right hand is not reconstructed: only its fingertips appear at the frame edge, so its mesh is marked invalid and drawn grey.
The left hand is invalid in 25 % of frames (fast blurred turns, occlusion by the cube); those frames are drawn grey.

Object depth from the known cube size and hand depth from the hand model disagree (ratio about 0.39, object-pose consistency check), so the cube may appear far from the hand in the 3D view. No rescaling is applied.

versions.agentic: Agentic Reconstruction: object prompt adapted to video-only inputs; Blender-built object models; MANO fit (HaWoR init + default fitting package); GPT-6 Astra (high), Codex CLI 0.163.0
versions.do_as_i_do: Do as I Do reconstruction pipeline (malik-group/do-as-i-do, reconstruction/): SAM 3, SAM 3D Objects, MoGe, HaWoR, GeoCalib, TAPIR, Fast-SAM3D, run and integrated by GPT-6 Astra (high), Codex CLI 0.163.0

limitations: Equal budgets: same model and settings, 2 GPUs, 22 CPU threads and 160 GiB each, the same inputs; the comparison points are 30 min, 1 h, 1.5 h and 2 h after start.
Reference masks are an independent 2D reference, not 3D ground truth; mask agreement verifies position and outline, not full 3D orientation.

Agentic Reconstruction builds its object models from the given object dimensions; parts of its motion are modelled (tennis free flight constrained to gravity, pen roll and ball spin held fixed, cube layer turns not reconstructed).
Do as I Do's object meshes come from SAM 3D Objects at the pipeline's own metric scale (the plugs come out at about two thirds of their real size).
Both agents stopped 3 h 32 min after start on a shared usage limit; results after 2 h are not part of this comparison.
tennis.caption: Reconstruction comparison of the human demonstration, not an official target evaluation. Left: the original video. Middle and right: each method's reconstructed objects and hands, projected into the same frames, as delivered 2 hours after start. Frames without a valid estimate are labelled; nothing is cut.
tennis.producer: recon-bench (operator-side evaluation, independent of both runs)
